label: Contrado
terms_note: api_encouraged (private store/account tokens self-service; 429 rate-limit semantics and HMAC-signed webhooks documented)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes**.Confidence: **high** — official developer documentation opened by t
auth: 1. Tenant creates a Contrado store and generates an API key

endpoints.purpose: place order for a registered customer

reference.limits: Not in the spec. - Self-serve key - POD: products must exist in the user's Contrado store first

fields.name: api_key
fields.help: Contrado Helix private token (Contrado Store Account > API Integration; shown once at creation), sent as `X-API-Key`. Scopes: StoresRead, StoreProductsRead, StoreOrdersRead.

fields.name: store_id
fields.help: Store id sent as `X-Store-Id`; needed only with an account-level token (a store-level token already names its store).

me.note: GET /helix/v1/stores returns the envelope {success, message, data: {storeId, storeName, storeURL, cultureCode, ...}} for the stores the token can access (scope StoresRead). Rate limit 100 requests/minute.

list_products.note: GET /helix/v1/stores/products (scope StoreProductsRead): the store's designed products [{storeProductId, baseProductId, storeProductName, storeProductDescription, productThumb, productImages, storeProductURL, collectionId, isOutOfStock}] inside the {success, data} envelope; `query` and `category` are not accepted (products of one collection come from /stores/collections/{collectionId}/products, not mapped). Prices come from /stores/products/{id}/option-variants (not mapped).

get_product.note: GET /helix/v1/stores/products/{storeProductId}: data {storeProductId, storeProductName, productThumb, productImages, product3dImages, productSpecification, sizeChart, productionTime, shippingPriceGroupId, isOutOfStock}.

get_order.note: GET /helix/v1/orders/{orderId} (scope StoreOrdersRead; orderId is Contrado's integer order id): data {orderId, orderStatus, referenceId, externalReferenceId, orderedUtcDateTime, orderTrackingStatus, trackingId, trackingUrl, totalPrice, currencyCode, deliveryAddress, orderLineItems, orderSummary}.

not_offered.create_order: POST /helix/v1/orders/create takes StoreOrderRequestModel {externalReferenceId, recipient, lineItem[{storeProductId, variantId, selectedOptions, quantity, price}], totalAmount, currencyCode, cultureCode} and rejects 'Invalid quantity or pricing format'; the vocabulary carries no order total or currency, so the body cannot be built without inventing values.
not_offered.quote_shipping: GET /helix/v1/shipping/{cultureCode} returns the store's shipping price groups and regional rates per culture code, not a quote for a product_id/country/quantity.
not_offered.track: GET /helix/v1/orders/{orderId}/shipment/status answers a single object {courierName, shippingService, trackingId, shipmentStatus, deliveryEstimateDate, trackingUrl}, not a list of events; the tracking id and URL are part of get_order.

evidence: probe: 4/4 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 502 (server_error), so the answers are path-specific
spec https://api.contrado.app/helix/swagger/v1/swagger.json: 4/4 tools match (path, method, parameters, body keys, response paths)
auth_audit.notes: Response envelope unresolved: the swagger has no data wrapper, the docs page describes {success, data}. list_products: spec says "response path items='data' is not in the response schema"; waived: the Helix swagger describes the payload inside Contrado's {success, data} envelope (the adapter follows https://api.contrado.app/helix/docs/); which one the live API returns needs a real key get_product: spec says "response path root='data' is not in the response schema"; waived: the Helix swagger describes the payload inside Contrado's {success, data} envelope (the adapter follows https://api.contrado.app/helix/docs/); which one the live API returns needs a real key get_order: spec says "response path root='data' is not in the response schema"; waived: the Helix swagger describes the payload inside Contrado's {success, data} envelope (the adapter follows https://api.contrado.app/helix/docs/); which one the live API returns needs a real key
